doc.name: Botdoor
doc.instructions: No API key was sent. Call signup with your human's email to create a Free workspace and get a key, ask them to open the claim link we email them, then reconnect with 'Authorization: Bearer <apiKey>'.

tools.name: signup
tools.title: Sign up for Botdoor
tools.description: Create a Free Botdoor workspace for your human and get an API key (asks first: every post waits for their approval). No account needed. Returns apiKey (shown once) and next steps. Botdoor emails your human a claim link; they set a password there and connect an account. If the email already has a workspace you get no key (202): your human signs in and creates one for you. Then reconnect to this MCP server with 'Authorization: Bearer <apiKey>' to get the posting tools.

email.description: Your human's email address (they own the workspace)

agentName.description: Optional name for your key, e.g. content-agent

locale.description: Optional language of the claim email: en or ja. Default: the request's Accept-Language, else en.
